candidate.answerReason: Each hectare is 10000 square meters, so 2 hectares is 2 × 10000 = 20000 square meters.

methods.label: Hectare conversion
methods.explanation: 1 hectare = 10000 square meters. Since 2 hectares is twice that area, it equals \(2 \times 10000 = 20000\) square meters.
methods.levelReason: Uses the grade 4 hectare conversion and elementary doubling.
